item.title: Small Space Irrigation for Urban Balconies
item.description: Urban balconies present a unique irrigation challenge: maximum plant density in minimal square footage, often with strict aesthetic requirements and zero tolerance for leaks or overflow. Standard drip kits designed for suburban patios assume space you don’t have and flexibility your landlord won’t allow. This guide covers irrigation approaches specifically engineered for urban balconies under 50 square feet—the kind of tight spaces common in apartment buildings, condos, and dense city neighborhoods.
